written: 2026-11-07 ~23:20 CT, before any result of this experiment (gamma result: neutral on validation, recorded separately)
finding: On stable train machines the win rule is XNOR or XOR of win/loss at one of three lag pairs (1,3),(2,5),(4,7): 6 hypotheses cover 152/183 machines; context purity median 0.916.
model_SWM: Structural win model: per machine, Bayesian posterior over H = {6 pair x rule hypotheses} + {null: constant rate}. Likelihood of each observed spin t (needs t-a and t-b observed, else hypothesis abstains -> uses null rate): win ~ Bernoulli(p_on) if rule true else Bernoulli(p_off). Log-likelihoods forgotten with lam_h (handles drift/shared_change). Prior over H = train frequencies. P(win at cutoff) = sum_h post(h) * pred_h.
parameters_fit_on_fit_split_only: p_on, p_off pooled from fit-split machines (closed form from best-hypothesis counts); lam_h in {1.0, 0.99, 0.97} and null-rate decay chosen by fit-split query-label log score.
stage1: Compare SWM P(win) vs champion P(win) (= 1 - p_0 from registry OOF trial a2c0acc4) with win-indicator Brier on the SAME 4 grouped train folds (fit SWM on 3 folds' machines, predict the held-out fold's queries). Report per condition, especially short_history, with paired episode bootstrap.
stage2_if_stage1_promising: Hybrid: champion size distribution x SWM P(win), and a convex mix of champion and SWM P(win) with weight chosen by nested OOF. Selection on train folds only; official validation once for the selected hybrid.
expected: SWM P(win) beats champion P(win) on short_history; roughly equal or worse on long histories (champion has 73 experts + stacker); hybrid gains mainly on short_history.
decision: Issue + PR only if the selected hybrid improves train-fold Brier (interval excludes 0) AND official validation does not get worse.
